experiments.scope: The exact sha3-256-r5-prefix-v1 target. The program runs the campaign CAMP of proof.md Section 5 at a reduced budget and does not rerun SEL: once per run it replays the first block (one five-round call computes N) and checks Lemmas 1 and 2 on the embedded chart (shared tail; rank 141; distinct bases). Each organizer trial is one complete campaign with its own coins (random.Random seeded by the trial seed): six uniform invertible 135 x 135 matrices drawn column by column (at most 128 draws per column) and six translations; 16 Gray visits per set in round-robin order through the incremental generator of Lemma 4; rounds 0 to 2 and the third-chi filter on every visit; for a survivor rounds 3 and 4 and a 176-byte record (digest, fragment, padding), at most 8 records; the 32-pass byte radix sort on the digest between two arrays; the adjacent scan; native verification of an equal-digest pair. In trials with index divisible by 4 the six translations are replaced by stored survivors of our preregistered sample, so that records, sorting and the scan run on real survivors. Checks beside the algorithm: every visit is tested against both earlier chi targets, and every record digest against the complete hash of its message.
experiments.hypothesis: No trial returns a pair: a collision at this budget would need about 2^78 records. The run shows that the shipped program executes the scored algorithm end to end on the target. Its 16 untrusted counts per trial satisfy exactly: visits = 96 unless the record cap stops the walk; free_xors = visits - 6; parities = 6 free_xors; rounds = 3 visits + 2 survivors; records = survivors <= 8; radix_passes = 32 if records >= 2 else 0; comparisons = records - 1 (0 if none); verify_calls = 4 per equal-digest pair; planted = 6 in trials with index divisible by 4, else 0; column_draws >= 810; prefix_calls = 1 in trial 0, else 0; invalid = 0; record_mismatch = 0. Planted trials have 6 survivors; other trials almost always none (2^-18 per visit). Nothing about cost or the premises is inferred from the run.
